test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

It __was delightful to heard__ the baby's voice.
solution:
The correct answer is** "was delightful to hear"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's see the correct sentence formation:

__
 
• It ***was delightful to hear*** the baby's voice.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's see here how the sentence formed:

 
• **Was delightful to hear - **extremely pleased (to do something)

 
 
• ***Eg.*** I'm *delighted to hear* the arrival of the baby.
